question: Who won the Dronacharya Award 2018 in Table Tennis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A Srinivasa Rao.**__

__
 
• ​**Shri A. Srinivasa Rao** won the **Dronacharya Award for 2018** in the field of **Table Tennis**.
 
• **Award Name**: Dronacharya Award for excellence in sports coaching.
 
• **Achievements**: He has trained several notable Table Tennis players who have won medals in both national and international competitions.
 
• **Profession**: Table Tennis coach.
 
• **Players Trained:** Some prominent players he has coached include:
 
 
• Achanta Sharath Kamal
 
• Kumaresan Shamini
 
• Chetan P. Baboor
 
• S. Raman
 
• Neha Agarwal
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dronacharya Award:**
 
• **Purpose:** The Dronacharya Award is presented for excellence in sports coaching. It aims to honor coaches who have made significant contributions to their respective sports and have played a crucial role in training athletes who achieve success at national and international levels.
 
• **Inception**: The award was established by the Government of India in 1985. It is named after Dronacharya, a revered character in the Indian epic Mahabharata, known for his exceptional teaching abilities.
 
• **Eligibility**: Coaches across various sports disciplines are eligible for this award. The focus is on those who have shown outstanding performance in training athletes and have contributed significantly to sports in India.
 
• **Award Structure:**
 
 
• Recipients receive a medal, a scroll of honor, and a cash prize.
 
• The cash prize has been set at ₹5 lakh since 2020, but it may vary in earlier years .
 
 
 
• **Nomination Process**: Coaches can be nominated by national sports federations or other recognized bodies. The selection committee evaluates the nominees based on their track record, the performance of the athletes they coached, and their overall contribution to sports .
 
• **Categories**: The award is generally given for two categories:
 
• **Lifetime Achievement Award:** For coaches who have made long-standing contributions to sports coaching.
 
• **Regular Award**: For coaches who have shown exceptional performance in recent years .
 
• **Significance**: The Dronacharya Award serves to encourage and motivate coaches to continue developing sports in India. It highlights the importance of coaching in the development of athletes and the overall sports culture in the country .
 
• **Notable Recipients:** Over the years, many esteemed coaches have received this award, including those from sports such as athletics, boxing, wrestling, and cricket, acknowledging their exceptional guidance and mentorship .
 
• **Ceremony**: The award is presented annually, usually during the National Sports Day celebrations on August 29, honoring the birth anniversary of hockey legend Dhyan Chand .
